Pakistan Secures Tri-Series Title With Historic ODI Chase

02 Nov 2026, 12:30 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

A Record-Equaling Victory

In a high-scoring finale at Lahore, Pakistan claimed the One-Day International (ODI) tri-series title by defeating Sri Lanka with a successful chase of 326 runs. The victory marks a significant milestone, as Pakistan matched the record for the highest successful run chase in an ODI tournament final, previously set by India during the 2002 NatWest Series at Lord's.

This win also serves as a notable achievement for the host nation, ending a trophy drought in tri-series competitions that dated back to their 2008 Kitply Cup victory.

Match Highlights

  • Sri Lanka’s Performance: Batting first, Sri Lanka reached a formidable total of 325 for eight. The innings was anchored by Kamindu Mendis, who scored 131, and Pavan Rathnayake, who contributed 77. The pair combined for a 146-run partnership.
  • Pakistan’s Response: Despite losing captain Babar Azam early for a duck, Pakistan stabilized their innings through a 149-run partnership between Fakhar Zaman and Saad Baig.
  • Key Contributions: Fakhar Zaman led the batting effort with a century, scoring 127 runs off 99 balls. Later, a 94-run stand between Arafat Minhas and Hasan Nawaz ensured the team crossed the finishing line with nine balls to spare.

Tactical Analysis

Pakistan's bowling attack was instrumental in restricting Sri Lanka's final total. Although Sri Lanka appeared poised to exceed 340 runs, late-over discipline from bowlers including Shaheen Shah Afridi helped limit the visitors to 325. Afridi concluded his spell with two wickets for 50 runs, while Naseem Shah also contributed by removing Sahan Arachchige.

For followers of the sport, official scorecards and post-match analysis can be verified through the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) or official international cricket regulatory body websites.
